title: EVOLVING AZIMUTH IN MUSA CONTEXT
summary: Non-pharmacological, randomized, nonprofit medical device intervention. The study aims to identify the positive impacts (co-creation), and negative impacts (co-destruction), resulting from the use of telemedicine, and, in particular, the telemonitoring service for patients with heart failure
sponsor: Fondazione IRCCS Ca' Granda, Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico
